ValidationRule.description: Entity/Site counting gate (Qualification_Criteria_Met_CC__c). Replaces the per-field Annual Revenue, Spend, Industry, Sub-Sector and Pallet Volume rules. Blank Lead Type is handled by Lead_Type_Required_for_Qualified_Lead_CC.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Engage"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified") ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Lead_Type_CC__c))), NOT(Qualification_Criteria_Met_CC__c), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the qualification questions for this Entity or Site. Entity: Industry, Industry Sub-Sector and any two of Annual Revenue, Estimated Annual Spend, Number of Locations and Daily Pallet Volume. Site: Estimated Annual Spend or Daily Pallet Volume.
